scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n be,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm -w packages/shared run build && npm -w packages/backend run build && npm -w packages/web run build
scripts.lint: npm -w packages/backend run lint && npm -w packages/web run lint
scripts.test: npm -w packages/shared run test && npm -w packages/backend run test && npm -w packages/web run test
